exposure: prophylactic internal iliac artery balloon catheterization
cohort: 163 women past 32 weeks' gestation with placenta previa-accreta at Tongji Hospital, Wuhan, China
finding: Prophylactic internal iliac artery balloon catheterization in women with placenta previa-accreta was effective in reducing intraoperative blood loss, perioperative hemostatic measures, and hysterectomies, without significant differences in neonatal outcomes.
